Lenovo IdeaPad 3 Student Laptop Computer

$569.99
The Lenovo IdeaPad 3 is the kind of student laptop that actually makes sense. Most budget laptops cut corners with slow Celeron or N-series processors, but this one packs a real Intel i5-13420H with 16GB of DDR5 RAM — that's desktop-class performance at a student price. The 15.6-inch FHD anti-glare display means you can study in the library, outdoors, or under terrible dorm lighting without fighting reflections. 256GB SSD is enough for all your coursework, and Office 365 comes included so you're not scrambling for a Word license before your first paper is due. The 180-degree hinge lays flat for group study sessions, and the physical webcam shutter is a nice privacy touch you don't usually see at this price.
